subject.title: fix(whatsapp): bound inbound media download with chunk-idle timeout

question: Should WhatsApp inbound media treat 30 seconds without a received chunk as a terminal download failure and release the inbound dispatch, or should this channel use a different fixed cutoff?
rationale: The patch is mechanically bounded and proof-backed, but the correct timeout balances recovery from permanently stalled Baileys streams against delivery of legitimate slow streams; source and tests cannot determine the desired product tolerance.

options.title: Accept the 30-second cutoff
options.body: Merge with the fixed 30-second per-chunk timeout, matching the cited channel timeout precedent and preventing a single stalled media stream from holding inbound dispatch indefinitely.

options.title: Retune the cutoff
options.body: Keep the same helper and teardown behavior but change the constant to a WhatsApp-specific duration before merge.

options.title: Pause for channel telemetry
options.body: Defer merging until maintainers can validate the expected chunk-gap distribution for real WhatsApp media downloads.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second cutoff
recommendation.body: Merge with the fixed 30-second per-chunk timeout, matching the cited channel timeout precedent and preventing a single stalled media stream from holding inbound dispatch indefinitely.
